name: suppliers_rank
parts: SBAL (U32): supplier rows in descending s_acctbal order (row positions only), or empty
PSMETA (I64 [mode, kmin]): mode 1 = dense directory over ps_suppkey values kmin .. kmin + nk
PSOFFS (U32, nk + 1): positions offs[e] .. offs[e + 1] of PSPERM hold the partsupp rows of ps_suppkey kmin + e
PSPERM (U32): partsupp row positions grouped by ps_suppkey (rows ascending within a key)

layout.summary: storage suppliers unchanged (48 inherited parts), then a permutation of the supplier rows by s_acctbal descending and a dense ps_suppkey directory of partsupp (I64 [mode, kmin], U32 offsets, U32 permutation of the partsupp rows grouped by ps_suppkey)
layout.units: row positions of suppliers' stored (canonical) supplier and partsupp rows; directory entry e is ps_suppkey kmin + e; offsets are permutation positions
